question: What kind of warranty do you offer on your bird netting installation?
answer:

We offer a comprehensive warranty ranging from 3 to 5 years on our bird netting installations, depending on the specific product and application. This warranty covers manufacturing defects in the HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene) material and premature degradation due to weather exposure. Our nets are UV stabilized to withstand the harsh Chennai sun, ensuring long-lasting performance.

The warranty is valid only if the safety nets are installed by our trained and certified professionals. This ensures proper installation techniques are followed, maximizing the lifespan and effectiveness of the netting. It doesn't cover damage caused by misuse, accidents, or unauthorized modifications.
